headline: Pentagon Procurement Deadline to Ban Chinese Rare Earths in Defense Supply Chain
summary: Pentagon rules taking effect January 1 will restrict Chinese-origin rare earth materials across American weapon systems, impacting the entire supply chain from mining to refining and melting.
why: The U.S. Department of Defense is enforcing supply chain decoupling for critical minerals, which affects defense contractors and accelerates demand for non-Chinese rare earth producers.

impacts.name: Rare Earth Elements
impacts.why: Exclusion of Chinese sources redirects Pentagon defense contractor demand toward alternative producers.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Defense primes face operational adjustments and potential compliance costs to certify non-Chinese minerals.
